name: mastodon
description: Mentions, quotes, posts you asked to be told about, ended polls and follow requests from your Mastodon notifications, read from your own server with a token that can only read notifications. Read-only: it never posts, boosts, follows or dismisses anything.

requires.help: Save the address of your Mastodon server in that file, for example https://mastodon.example

On your Mastodon server, open Preferences, Development, New application. Untick every permission except read:notifications, save, open the application and copy "Your access token" into that file. Then run chmod 600 on it. Steps: extractors/mastodon/README.md.
